identity: Keep the exact approved small curled ginger-and-white kitten, closed relaxed eyes, rounded ears, painted soft fur, warm light. Preserve markings, head proportions and compact silhouette. No new cartoon/3D style.
camera: Locked orthographic-style side/front camera. Fixed framing and source canvas. No zoom, camera motion or entire-character scaling. Feet/contact shadows must stay on a single ground line.

clips.name: sleep
clips.prompt: A continuous restful sleep loop. Subtle ribcage movement only; head, paws and floor contact remain still. No whole-body breathing scale. Same first and last pose.

clips.name: wake
clips.prompt: Begin in the exact sleep pose. Eyelids open, then ears attend, then head lifts gently with neck and shoulder follow-through. Natural small feline weight transfer; paws do not slide.

clips.name: idle-blink
clips.prompt: Quiet attentive kitten with one irregular slow eyelid blink, tiny ear swivel and gentle head settling. Body weight remains grounded. Not a repeated metronome bob.

clips.name: yawn-stretch
clips.prompt: A small natural feline yawn and stretch. Eyelids narrow, jaw opens and closes, neck extends, spine lengthens, front paws press into the floor and weight transfers gradually. Full articulated anatomy; not a mouth-open still with a zoom effect.

clips.name: play
clips.prompt: A single small playful paw reach toward its own tail, a short head follow and gentle return. Stay within the original floor footprint; no extra toys, props, humans or scene changes.

clips.name: settle-sleep
clips.prompt: Turn the head gently down, draw paws in, curl into the exact approved resting shape and settle the chin. End in the original sleep reference pose without a cut or snap.

deliverable: Editable rig/animation source if artist-produced; for generated video retain original clip, exact prompt, model, job id and processing provenance. Never label generated video as a rig. Runtime RGBA sequence or transparent lossless animated WebP with fixed canvas/ground line, plus poster and content bounds. Verify alpha edges on cream and dark surfaces.
acceptance: Compare beside V5 at actual phone/tablet size
No sliding paws, floating ground, identity drift or mouth-only stretch
Measure native frame time, decoded memory and battery
Only after cat acceptance produce dog, monkey and lion with species-specific motion
sound: Cat purr exists as a licensed recording. Other species require their own licensed/approved quiet recordings; do not reuse cat purr for lion/monkey/dog. No automatic attention-seeking calls.
